title: Ocean.io Review (2026)
intro: Ocean.io is evaluated here as sales intelligence software — Sales intelligence platform centered on lookalike and similar-company prospecting — finding companies like your best customers — monetized via a credit model with a published per-credit rate and yearly minimum packaging. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s sales-intelligence methodology (contact data, prospecting, enrichment, email outreach, CRM sync, usability, reporting, value). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Ocean.io when lookalike / similar-company prospecting is the named buying job and you can model credit minimums.
verdict: Choose Ocean.io when lookalike / similar-company prospecting is the named buying job and you can model credit minimums. Compare Clay for multi-provider waterfall enrichment, Apollo for data+sequences, ZoomInfo for enterprise databases, and Bombora when third-party intent (not lookalikes) is the specialist need. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Is Ocean.io a CRM?
faq.answer: No. Ocean.io is sales intelligence / prospecting software. Keep a CRM of record (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, etc.) and use Ocean.io for discovery, enrichment, intent, or account prioritization as applicable.

faq.question: How is Ocean.io priced?
faq.answer: Usage/credit model about $0.063/credit; minimum about 9,000 credits; yearly about $567 (~$47.25/mo). Free trial where offered. Custom contact-sales for larger packaging. Confirm on ocean.io/pricing.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Ocean.io?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
